business_overview.one_sentence: Fountain Set is a Hong Kong listed textile manufacturer producing dyed fabrics, yarns and garments through knitting, dyeing, printing, finishing and garment manufacturing operations.

segments.name: Production and sales of dyed fabrics and yarns

business_overview.revenue_model: Manufacturing and sale of textile products to apparel retailers and brands, with production facilities mainly in mainland China, Sri Lanka and Indonesia and trading offices in Hong Kong, mainland China, Macao, Vietnam and Japan.
business_notes: 2023 revenue fell 26.7%, mainly due to a 22.9% decline in fabric sales volume.
The group disclosed inventory turnover of 69 days, trade and bills receivable turnover of 66 days and trade and bills payable turnover of 58 days.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow exceeded reported profit in 2023, but was driven by working-capital release during revenue decline and included a large non-recurring land resumption gain in reported earnings. 2022 was loss-making despite very strong working-capital release. A low profit haircut is required for owner earnback.

gaps: The annual report does not split unrestricted cash and bank deposits by listed parent, Hong Kong subsidiaries, mainland China subsidiaries, Sri Lanka subsidiaries or other operating locations.
No note was found that proves a rapid dividend, repayment or liquidation path for cash held inside mainland China operating subsidiaries.
Only 2022 and 2023 operating cash flow and capital expenditure were extracted from the 2023 annual report; 2021 cash-flow detail was not included in this period's fact pack.
Maintenance capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; 2023 purchases of property, plant and equipment were used as a conservative proxy.
